P.name: Petricite Burst
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Sylas''' casts an {{tip|ability}}, he generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Unshackled'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 3 times.
P.description2: {{sbc|Unshackled:}} '''Sylas'''' next {{tip|basic attack}} gains {{as|{{sti|125% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and consume a stack to whirl his chains around him, dealing {{as|130% AD}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to the primary target and {{as|40% AD}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
P.description3: ''Unshackled'' deals 115% damage to {{tip|monsters}}, and executes {{tip|minions}} that are secondary targets and would be left below {{sti|{{as|25 health}}}}.
P.description4: ''Petricite Burst'' can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|175|100}}|critical damage}} damage only against the primary target.

Q.name: Chain Lash
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sylas''' lashes out two chains that converge to the target location and extend beyond it up to a maximum range, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
Q.description2: After a {{fd|0.6}}-second delay, the chains' intersection explodes to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within, reduced to 40% against {{tip|minions}}.

W.name: Kingslayer
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sylas''' {{tip|dashes}} to the front of the target enemy's location then strikes them to deal {{as|magic damage}}.
W.description2: If this damages a {{tip|champion}}, '''Sylas''' is also {{tip|heal|healed}}, increased by {{as|{{pp|type=his '''missing''' health|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 60|formula=1% per 0.6% of '''Sylas'''' '''missing''' health}}|health}}.
W.leveling2: {{st|Minimum Heal|{{ap|20 to 100}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} {{as|(+ 5% of his '''bonus''' health)}}|Maximum Heal|{{ap|20*2 to 100*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*2}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*2}}% of his '''bonus''' health)}}}}

E.name: Abscond
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sylas''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location. Within {{fd|3.5}} seconds, he can cast ''{{ai|Abduct|Sylas}}'' after a {{tt|{{fd|0.2}}-second delay|Starts on-cast, not after completing the dash}} from casting ''Abscond''.
E.description2: ''{{ai|Kingslayer|Sylas}} can be cast during the dash.''

E.name: Abduct
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sylas''' whips out his chains in the target direction that deal {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|standard sight|reveal}} and {{tip|stun|stun}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. Upon hitting the target, '''Sylas''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to their location and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds upon arrival.
E.description2: '''''Sylas''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to cast {{ai|Chain Lash|Sylas}} while the chains are in flight.''

R.name: Hijack
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sylas''' launches his chains at the target enemy champion, gaining a copy of their {{tip|champion ability|ultimate ability}} and {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for {{tt|{{fd|0.825}} seconds|Estimated, from start of cast time}}. '''Sylas''' cannot select the same champion again for a set duration, and can hold the ''hijacked'' ultimate for up to 90 seconds, during which he can recast ''Hijack''.
R.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Sylas''' casts his hijacked ultimate ability at no cost, scaling based on ''Hijack's'' rank and his own [[Champion statistic|statistics]].
R.description3: ''Hijacked'' ultimates and abilities that do not scale with {{as|{{sti|ability power}}}} have their {{as|{{sti|attack damage}}}} ratios converted to {{as|ability power}} ratios, scaling with {{as|{{fd|0.6}}% AP}} per {{as|1% '''total''' AD}}, and {{as|{{fd|0.4}}% AP}} per {{as|1% '''bonus''' AD}} respectively.
R.cooldown: {{tt|{{ap|80 to 30}}|Starts on cast and restarts on recast or when hold duration ends}}
